<quoted>
----- Forwarded by Christian Thompson on 07/04/2025 11:40 -----

	Mandy Castano@halcyonbank.co.uk
	02/05/2025 05:46 PM
		 
		 To: Christian Thompson
		 cc: 
		 Subject: Document Retention Policy

Christian:  We have learned from Stephen Patterson that you are in the process of updating Halcyon Mutual Bank's document retention policy.  What will the policy be with regard to retaining drafts of loan agreements after a particular transaction has closed?  It is our understanding that Halcyon Mutual Bank's current policy is to discard all drafts post-closing.   We are in the process of formalizing our own document retention policy, and want to ensure that our practices line up with Halcyon Mutual Bank's. Please advise.  Mandy (Halcyon Mutual Bank Legal)
</quoted>
